description: Existing version-1 Astro static portfolio for Giles Butler, a product-minded creative engineer and co-founder of Fuzzy Logic Labs.

goals.description: Present Giles Butler's product engineering, frontend, design, and full-stack experience.
Maintain site copy, navigation, SEO, contact content, and case studies from clear source locations.
Continuously publish a reliable static site from main through Netlify.
Use semi-autonomous assistance without babysitter triggers in production CI/CD.

modules.name: Site configuration
modules.description: Single source for identity, copy, navigation, sections, SEO, form, and footer.

modules.name: Routes
modules.description: Home, about, work index/detail, contact, 404, and service-worker cleanup route.

modules.name: Content collections
modules.description: Glob-loaded work and journal Markdown validated with Zod.

modules.name: Styles
modules.description: Centralized theme tokens and responsive styles.

architecture.dataFlow: Build-time Astro content/config loading produces dist/; Netlify publishes dist/. Contact posts to Netlify Forms. There is no database or application API.

team.name: Adam Arbolino
responsibilities: Co-founded Fuzzy Logic Labs and collaborated on represented products

team.name: Asta Bankauske
responsibilities: Dependency maintenance and GitHub merge activity

workflows.name: content-update
workflows.description: Plan or update content, build, and inspect generated routes.

workflows.name: verification
workflows.description: Build-based smoke verification; no unit-test framework exists.
steps: Assert required dist routes and identity

workflows.name: netlify-deployment
steps: Netlify runs npm run build with Node 22

services.name: Netlify
services.role: Primary hosting, builds, publishing, Forms, CAPTCHA, and honeypot

painPoints.description: No unit, integration, lint, or dedicated test suite; confidence relies on build and route smoke checks.
Dependency updates historically use a repeated manual external-fork PR loop.
HEADSHOTS_TODO.md and placeholder case-study imagery indicate remaining asset work.

bottlenecks.description: Manual build-and-route verification is the primary quality gate.

bottlenecks.impact: Recurring maintenance effort and possible update lag.

bottlenecks.description: No tags, releases, changelog, or semver markers.
bottlenecks.impact: Release boundaries are hard to audit.

git.mergeStrategy: GitHub PR merges plus direct content/config commits

codeStyle.styling: Global CSS tokens and CSS variables

conventions.errorHandling: Fail-fast shell verification and Zod/Astro content validation.
conventions.testingConventions: Use npm run build and deterministic generated-route/content assertions; no unit-test framework.
additionalRules: Keep site static unless explicitly required otherwise.
Do not add babysitter CI/CD triggers.
Use OpenSpec for changes that warrant planning.
Gitignore policy: Logs only; ignore .a5c/creds.env, .a5c/creds.env.tmp.*, and .a5c/logs/.

claudeMdInstructions: Use Astro 7 static-site conventions with Node 22 and existing repository data/content/asset paths.
Use Netlify as the primary deployment target; publish dist/ via the configured build, and treat Vercel/Cloudflare as secondary manual targets.
Do not add Babysitter CI/CD integration, CI triggers, deployment pipelines, dependencies, or new process files without explicit approval.
Work semi-autonomously for routine reversible edits; request approval for consequential, irreversible, production, security-sensitive, dependency, deletion, migration, or scope changes.
Use OpenSpec for spec-worthy work and run strict validation plus change status checks before implementation.

Use .a5c/processes/portfolio-content-update.js for full portfolio-content updates, .a5c/processes/homepage-annotation-update.js for homepage annotation requests, and .a5c/processes/verify-portfolio.sh for build/route/content smoke verification.
Use the documented npm, OpenSpec, and verification commands; preserve existing process hard gates and do not invent substitute workflows.
installedAgents: Review and verification roles referenced by processes
